title: docs(guide): slotted-pages header example keeps only PageHeaderProps keys; pin it (objectui#11165)
body:
Fixes #11165
Clause-②: no

## What changed

- `content/docs/guide/slotted-pages.md`, "Example: customize only the header": `slots.header` keeps only keys `PageHeaderProps` accepts. `eyebrow` (never declared) and `icon` (ADR-0087 D2 tombstone) are gone. A short lead-in now points at the [Page Header reference](/docs/layout/page-header) for the prop list. `breadcrumb: true` stays, per the dispatch ruling: it follows its own card (objectui#11166), and this PR does not touch it.
- New pin `examples/schema-catalog/test/slotted-pages-header-example-11165.test.ts`, beside the nearest docs-example pin for this node (`pageheader-with-actions.test.tsx`, which pins the `page-header.mdx` demo). No test read `slotted-pages.md` before this. The pin reads the fence from the page and evaluates it (the `readme-dashboard-examples-spec-valid.test.ts` technique), so it follows the page and does not restate the node. It asserts:
  1. the header node passes `safeValidateSchema` (the schema mirror `objectui validate` runs);
  2. its `properties` pass `ComponentPropsMap['page:header']` in a full parse;
  3. CONTROL: the same node with `eyebrow` and `icon` put back (the node the page taught before) is refused by both judges on exactly those two keys.

## Re-measure at base `5262f7dd3`, before any edit

- `safeValidateSchema(old node)`: `properties.icon: invalid_type`, `properties: unrecognized_keys [eyebrow]`. Without the two keys: OK.
- `PageHeaderProps.safeParse(old properties)`: `icon: invalid_type`, `: unrecognized_keys [eyebrow]`. Without them: OK.
- The whole page under `PageSchema` parses OK with or without the two keys. The page shape does not judge a component's `properties` by its `type`, so the pin asks the row.

## Rest of the page (same defect class: `page:*` nodes carrying keys their row refuses)

Measured at base. Every `page:*` node on the page passes `safeValidateSchema`, `PageComponentSchema` and its row. The only defect was the example above.
- The `regions` fence under "The discussion panel is composed, never appended": `page:header` with `title`. OK.
- "Naming the actions" fence: `page:header` with `title`, `actions`. OK.
- "Declaring placement" fence: `page:header` with `title`, `maxVisible`. OK.

## Verification (head `ca770c6a`)

- Pin: `pnpm exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2 examples/schema-catalog/test/slotted-pages-header-example-11165.test.ts` gives `Tests 4 passed (4)`. Run under the shared verify lock at `ca770c6a`, after the ablation restore.
- Ablation (one, committed first): `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs` (objectstack checkout) planted `eyebrow: 'ACCOUNT',` back into the page fence. Anchor x1 to x0, blob `4d1327d81019` to `7c97d87158d5`. Result: `Tests 2 failed | 2 passed (4)`. Both positive legs went red, with `properties: unrecognized_keys eyebrow` (mirror) and `: unrecognized_keys eyebrow` (row). The lit control and the refusal control stayed green. Restore: blob back to `4d1327d81019` = HEAD, `git diff HEAD` empty. My first attempt was a no-op that the tool refused: its replacement contained its anchor, so the anchor count could not drop. It restored without running the test.
- Gates at `ca770c6a`, each exit 0:
  - `check:doc-fences` (`--self-test` and scan);
  - `docs:check-links`: "Links are valid across 17 scan roots";
  - `check:control-bytes`;
  - `check:doc-types`;
  - `check:doc-example-ids`;
  - `check-new-cross-file-line-citations`: 0 new;
  - `check-test-path-roots`: the new read is classified, not cwd-rooted;
  - `check-lint-coverage` and `check-type-check-coverage`;
  - `check-changeset-presence`: "no changeset is owed". This is a docs and test-only change, so there is no changeset and no `skip-changeset` label.
- Lint: `eslint --no-inline-config --format json` on the two changed files. The test file was linted: 0 errors, 0 warnings. The `.md` is outside eslint's own population ("File ignored because no matching configuration was supplied"). `eslint.config.js` enables no type-aware linting, so this diff cannot move any untouched file's verdict. The full `pnpm lint` run belongs to CI.

## NOT MEASURED locally (owed to CI)

- `check:doc-snippets` (`check-doc-snippet-types.mjs`). The gate needs its 35-package `--build-filter` closure built. That was not run, because three devs share this container's memory. Narrowed instead: the edited fence alone was compiled with `tsc --strict` against the installed `@objectstack/spec`, and exited 0. The pre-fix fence also compiles (exit 0), which is why no snippet gate saw this defect. A control with an unknown page-level key fails TS2353, so the program does type-check. The fence imports only `@objectstack/spec/ui`, so no objectui `dist` enters its program, and no other fence's bytes changed.
- The full `type-check` of `@object-ui/example-schema-catalog`. It needs that package's devDependency closure built. Narrowed instead: `@object-ui/types` was built (the new test's only workspace import), and the new test file alone was compiled under a temporary config extending `tsconfig.test.json`. Exit 0, and the file appears in `--listFiles`.
- The repo-wide `pnpm test`, and `unit-registry-absence-collision` for the new unit-project file. The new file imports only `@object-ui/types/zod` and `@objectstack/spec/ui`, and neither registers a component.

## Acceptance notes

- **Brief vs triage on `breadcrumb`.** The triage comment's direction dropped `breadcrumb` too, citing objectui#11166's RETIRE ruling. The dispatch ruling and the claim keep it, so it stays. When the spec tombstones `breadcrumb`, this pin's row leg goes red. That is the prompt for objectui#11166 to edit this example.
- **Out of the brief's `page:*` scope, not touched.** The `record:related_list` JSON fence under "Naming a related list's actions" writes its props beside `type`, not in `properties`. Measured at base:
  - `safeValidateSchema` accepts it;
  - `PageComponentSchema` refuses it with `: unrecognized_keys [objectName, relationshipField, columns, actions]`;
  - inside a spec `Page` (`regions[].components[]`), `PageSchema` refuses it with `regions.0.components.0: unrecognized_keys`.

  It goes to the dispatch report as a finding for the seat to grade.
